scope: First-area pilot only. Other five regions keep their existing authored levels and fights for later region-specific expansion.

regionalStudy.name: Дремучий грибной лес
regionalStudy.visualLanguage: Teal bioluminescent roots, violet umbrella mushrooms, dark forest silhouettes, hanging platforms, cyan waterfalls.
regionalStudy.mapReading: Multiple loops, vertical shafts and upper/lower passages; warm-stone save points and blue recovery springs. Detailed level board places tokens on main route, difficult platforming, secret room and beyond a guardian.

regionalStudy.name: Топи
regionalStudy.visualLanguage: Sickly green mist, submerged ruins, drooping vegetation and low bridges.
regionalStudy.mapReading: Descent from forest into broken horizontal causeways and a winding low route, with a tall spire at the edge.

regionalStudy.name: Гора Гроз
regionalStudy.visualLanguage: Cold blue lightning, pale clouds, jagged mountains and narrow gothic towers.
regionalStudy.mapReading: Long upward climb with switchbacks, suspended links and a summit guardian; several side loops return to the ascent.

regionalStudy.name: Колокольня Пустоши
regionalStudy.visualLanguage: Burnished amber sky, black bell towers, hanging chains, broken stone silhouettes.
regionalStudy.mapReading: Broad lower circuit feeding a vertical belfry with bridges and a high boss chamber.

regionalStudy.name: Забытые глубины
regionalStudy.visualLanguage: Cobalt and icy cyan caverns, pointed rock formations and buried cathedral architecture.
regionalStudy.mapReading: Deep central descent with interlocking chambers, long vertical connections and routes toward the lake and bell tower.

regionalStudy.name: Аметистовое озеро
regionalStudy.visualLanguage: Violet crystals, mirrored water, luminous pink edges and dark cavern islands.
regionalStudy.mapReading: Low looping circuit around water and crystal grottos; upper ledges branch above the main lake path.

pilotInterpretation.topology: Entry descends into roots. A gap leads to the underground stream and token 2. The root shaft climbs to token 3 and a breakable entrance to token 4. Dropping from the secret returns to the hearth. A stepped canopy ascent reaches the Forgotten Tree arena. The lower stream connects back to the hearth through a breakable root shortcut.
pilotInterpretation.boss: Споровая мать follows the named boss board; the level board calls its example mini-boss Грибной великан. This pilot retains the established Spore Mother character.
attacks: Locked ground markers then root eruptions
Five arcing spores, seven in phase two
Burrow with a locked emergence warning and relocation
Two low waves from a root sweep
pilotInterpretation.secondPhase: At half health, a harmless two-second four-pose awakening; then shorter recoveries, wider root patterns and denser spores. Warning duration remains intact.
pilotInterpretation.saveCompatibility: Existing five token IDs, defeated/cleared flags and Neon schema retained. Checkpoint resolves to new hearth. Rematch preserves earned progress. Broken roots and discovered-room tint are per visit.

artProduction.method: Built-in image_gen; PNG sources retained in art/forest. Exact requests in generate-prompts.json and ledge-prompt.txt. Pillow only converts and packs existing pixels, without drawing replacement illustrations.
artProduction.runtime: Six WebP assets, about 2.5 MiB combined; loaded with the forest and evicted outside the recent-region cache. Terrain is culled in both axes and drawn in visible tiles; no 4550x1600 scenery canvas. 60 Hz fixed simulation and 1.5 million output pixel cap retained.
